newsitem.title: USA: Quintiles ups offering to 4.8 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Quintiles ups offering to 4.8 mln shares.

text.p: Quintiles Transnational Corp said Friday it raised a previously announced secondary public offering to 4.8 million common shares from 4.0 million.
Of the total, it said the company will offer 1.4 million shares while certain shareholders will sell up to 3.385 million shares.

It said it estimates net proceeds at $84.6 million, which it will use for geographic expansion, addition of new services, potential acquisitions, capital expenditures, working capital and other general corporate purposes.
After the offering, it said it will have about 34.6 million shares outstanding.
Quintiles provides contract research, sales and market services to pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical device industries.
